text:
Marco Reyes: FYI ticket ACME-4823 just came in — customer on Dedicated reporting sharp p99 latency spike for embeddings since the 2026-03-15 runtime push. They see timeouts and queued requests. Link: https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-4823 :rotating_light:
Alice Chen: thanks marco. is there a minimal repro or logs attached in the ticket? severity and SLA tier?
Marco Reyes: attached logs show latency jump from ~120ms -> 900-1.2s for embeddings endpoint. Customer is on reserved capacity with 99.9% latency SLA. Marked P2 but customer is pushing.
Jordan Liu: heads up — Acme is on an annual reserved contract, CSM is concerned. they want ETA for a fix.
Alice Chen: ok. priya can your team triage whether this is a config/regression in serving runtime vs model variant? any quick mitigations (throttle, fallback to older runtime)?
Priya Nair: I'll pick this up. first pass: need to know if KV cache behavior changed in last runtime deploy. Marco — can you paste stack traces + full request shape (sequence lengths, batch sizes) in the ticket?
Marco Reyes: done, added sample payloads. batch size is typically 1-4, seq len ~512 for embeddings.
Ben Cooper: throwing in metrics — from infra: p99 token latency for embed-service spiked at 03:20 UTC on 2026-03-15 coincident with runtime 2026.03.15-rc2. error rate (5xx) also up ~0.8%. PromQL I used: rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="embed-service"}[5m]) by (le)
Priya Nair: quick repro locally: on rc2 with synthetic load I can reproduce the p99 jump. hypothesis: KV caching eviction policy changed, causing recompute cost to spike for embeddings path.
Alice Chen: if this is a regression in the runtime, we need to decide hotfix vs next scheduled release. what's the scope of the fix and risk of patching?
Priya Nair: fix is a 6-line change to cache eviction threshold and one added unit test. low-risk. we can backport to release branch and cut a patch release.
Olivia Park: release-engineering note — for a customer-impacting regression on Dedicated, our playbook says prefer a patch hotfix if low-risk and reversible. we can do a canary rollout to 5% then 25% then 100%.
Ben Cooper: monitoring checklist for canary: p99 latency, 5xx rate, queue length, GPU utilization. canary SLO: p99 <= 200ms and 5xx delta < 0.2% vs baseline for 30m.
Alice Chen: communications: CSM/Jordan to notify Acme we'll do a hotfix and share ETA. status page update and private incident note for them. sales needs an ETA within 2 hours.
Jordan Liu: I'll tell CSM to send a note: "we're deploying a targeted fix; canary expected in 1-2h, full rollout after validation."
Priya Nair: I'll prepare the patch branch now. steps: branch from release/v2026.03, cherry-pick fix, add unit test, CI, then request canary deploy. estimated dev + CI time ~45m.
Olivia Park: deploy steps for canary (ops):
```
# create patch release
git checkout -b hotfix/kv-eviction-20260315 release/v2026.03
git cherry-pick <commit>
# push, trigger CI
kubectl apply -f k8s/patch-canary.yaml --namespace=dedicated-acme
# scale canary to 5% traffic via routing policy
```
I'll run the k8s commands and open canary deployment ticket.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: hotfix/kv-eviction-20260315 -> dedicated cluster (5% traffic).
Ben Cooper: I'll wire dashboards and alerts to monitor. setting alert if p99 > 300ms for 5m or 5xx > 0.5%.
Priya Nair: if canary looks good for 30m we promote to 25% and run another 30m, then full. rollback plan: revert cherry-pick and force-routing back to previous variant; rollback script lives in runbooks/release/hotfix-rollback.sh
Alice Chen: launch criteria (agreed): root cause validated + unit test + canary p99 <=200ms & 5xx delta <0.2% for 30m at 25% traffic. rollforward only after SRE signoff.
Jordan Liu: customer comms draft: "we identified a runtime cache regression introduced on 2026-03-15. we're deploying a targeted patch; we'll update within 2 hours after canary validation and share release notes." CSM will send.
Marco Reyes: customer replied: please expedite, they're seeing errors in production workflows. :eyes:
Priya Nair: prioritizing it now. will push patch PR and tag @Olivia and @Ben for canary.
Olivia Park: PR created: https://git.redwood.internal/p/3274 hotfix/kv-eviction-20260315 -> ready for CI.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for hotfix/kv-eviction-20260315 (unit + integration).
Olivia Park: canary at 5% running for 20m, no increase in 5xx so far, p99 trending down to ~150ms.
Ben Cooper: looks stable. promoting to 25%.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic increased to 25% (hotfix/kv-eviction-20260315).
Ben Cooper: monitoring 25m into 25% — p99 steady, error delta <0.1%.
Alice Chen: decision: proceed to full rollout. Olivia, schedule full promotion and add release note. Jordan/CSM please send customer update with ETA for full rollout and note that we validated canary. :white_check_mark:
Olivia Park: promoting to 100% now. deploy-bot: Promotion complete.
Ben Cooper: post-deploy check 10m: p99 140-170ms, 5xx at baseline.
Alice Chen: action items recap:
- Priya: merge patch, close ticket ACME-4823, add unit test (in PR).
- Olivia: cut patch release + changelog, update runbook with rollback commands.
- Ben: keep monitoring for 24h and escalate if regressions.
- Jordan/CSM: send customer final update + status page entry.
Thanks team. :rocket:
